text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, February 15, 2018 Posted by admin on February 15th, 2018 
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +178 points. 
Wednesday the Dow was up +253.04 (+1.03%) at 24,893.49. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +0.70%. 
There were 24 Dow stocks up Wednesday. 
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Nike (NKE) +3.17% and Goldman Sachs (GS) +2.76%. 
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by McDonald’s (MCD) -1.48% and Verizon (VZ) -1.14%. 
Cisco (CSCO) has unveiled a plan to bring $67 billion that it holds overseas back to the United States this year by taking advantage of the recent rewrite of the tax code. 
In the week ending February 10, the advance figure for seasonally adjusted initial weekly unemployment insurance claims was 230,000, an increase of 7,000 from the previous week’s revised level. The previous week’s level was revised up by 2,000 from 221,000 to 223,000. The 4-week moving average was 228,500, an increase of 3,500 from the previous week’s revised average. The previous week’s average was revised up by 500 from 224,500 to 225,000. 
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended higher. 
The national average price of gasoline is down eight-tenths of a cent at $2.552 per gallon.
